description: Use when someone wants a list of local businesses in Central Austin, TX by kind (for example dentists, coffee shops, plumbers), optionally only ones with no website listed or with a phone or email. Returns name, category, address, website status and contact details, each linked to its source record. Only Central Austin is covered.

query.description: What kind of business, for example 'dentist' or 'coffee'

website.description: missing = no website listed (social pages only or none)

name: search_businesses

more.description: Where to see every match, when there are more than returned

results.description: Businesses: name, category, address, website status, contact details and source links

title: Find local businesses in Austin
